Since we are selecting exactly 1 task, no multi-hop dependency chain is needed, but the task itself is non-trivial as it requires exploration and visual identification.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate close enough to the red stained glass window on the stone brick building and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is the center of the red stained glass cluster at spawn-relative (9, 2, 7). Max distance of 8 blocks ensures the player has walked from spawn (~10 blocks away) to within clear visual range. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the glass.

scene_description: A small village-like area with four structures: a cobblestone L-shaped wall ruin near spawn (front-left), an oak planks cabin (rear-left), a brick building (front-right), and a stone brick building (rear-right, ~8 blocks from spawn). The red stained glass is embedded in the south and east walls of the stone brick building — 2 blocks on the south face and 1 on the east face. The player must turn and explore toward the stone brick building to find the glass.
task_text: Explore the area and find the red stained glass blocks.
design_notes: Red stained glass at ~9,2,6 / ~9,3,6 (south face) and ~10,2,8 (east face) of stone brick building. Player spawns at origin facing between cobblestone wall and oak planks cabin. Must turn ~45° right and walk ~8 blocks to reach the stone brick building and clearly see the red glass. Other buildings use clear glass panes as distractors. The brick building's reddish-brown color provides mild visual confusion from distance but is clearly different up close.
